patch.summary: Campaign Monitor implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement Campaign Monitor by mapping current email-marketing workflows to Campaign Monitor objects, confirming plan gates for premium capabilities, piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (Shopify, Salesforce, WordPress) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: confirm paid unlocks before go-live
Integrate after: data quality pass on Shopify

blocks.heading: Campaign Monitor day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat Campaign Monitor setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for email campaigns, newsletter builder, email templates before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves Brand-conscious teams prioritizing email design/templates before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate Shopify and Salesforce before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover must-have capabilities
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: No forever free plan — trial only
Do not expand seats until email campaigns is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: No forever free plan — trial only

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: Lite monthly send caps force upgrades for frequent senders

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: Premier jump is large vs Essentials at the same contact band

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: Some advanced features / website builder may be add-ons or higher-tier only

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: Campaign Monitor plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Lite
lines.description: 30-day trial · Unlocks: email campaigns, newsletter builder, email templates · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Essentials
lines.description: 30-day trial · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Premier
lines.description: 30-day trial · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Enterprise
lines.description: Contact sales · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.title: Validate email-marketing fit before a deep Campaign Monitor rollout
blocks.body: If Campaign Monitor fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft Campaign Monitor object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on email campaigns
If blocked, evaluate Mailchimp before sunk-cost expansion
